hook.en: Very light rolling moves on the muscles with built-in pauses; popular but with little strong evidence.
hook.ur: Bowen technique mein muscles ya tendons par bohat gentle rolling moves ke darmiyan pauses hotay hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Bowen Technique / Bowenwork is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (4 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Bowen Technique / Bowenwork kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 4 checks.)

text.en: Bowen technique uses gentle, brief rolling moves over muscles and tendons with pauses between sets of moves. Practitioners claim it 'resets' the body, but this has not been shown.
text.ur: Tom Bowen ke naam se mansoob is practice mein muscles/tendons par gentle, brief rolling moves aur un ke darmiyan pauses hotay hain. Pause riwayat ka hissa hai, proven physiology nahi. Relaxation ke bajaye patient ke pain aur movement goals se result judge karein. Proper medical assessment delay nahi honi chahiye.

simpler.en: Very light rolling moves on the muscles with built-in pauses; popular but with little strong evidence.

text.en: Like a light tap sequence with rests: it feels pleasant, but a pleasant feeling is not proof of a specific treatment effect.
text.ur: Halkay taps ki sequence ke darmiyan rest jaisa: feel pleasant ho sakta hai, lekin pleasant feeling specific treatment effect ka proof nahi.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** The pause is part of the tradition, not proven physiology.
**2.** Judge it by the patient's goals, such as movement or pain, not by relaxation alone.
**3.** It must not delay proper medical assessment.
text.ur: Patient history, symptoms aur goals assess karein. Touch gentle aur tolerated hona chahiye; exact move placement aur pauses formal training ke mutabiq hotay hain. Har diagnosis ke liye same sequence copy na karein.

text.en:
So when does **Bowen Technique / Bowenwork** make sense?
• Someone who wants a gentle, relaxing option after screening.
• Alongside, not instead of, exercise and medical care.
text.ur: Screening ke baad gentle relaxing option chahne walay ke liye, exercise aur medical care ke sath, un ki jagah nahi. Red flags, progressive weakness, severe headache, serious illness ya us region mein skin damage ho to use na karein.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Red flags, progressive weakness, severe headache or serious illness.
• Skin damage in the area.
• Using it to replace medical care.
**Stop rule:** Do not postpone referral for red-flag symptoms or replace established care for significant injury or neurologic disease.
text.ur: Bowen ko serious disease ka alternative treatment samajhna, prescribed care delay karna ya worsening symptoms ko normal kehna unsafe hai. Red flags aur relevant contraindications screen karein aur patient ko medical review ki zaroorat samjhayen.

steps.title: Screen
steps.detail: Check for red flags and understand the patient's goal.

steps.title: Explain the limited evidence
steps.detail: Be honest that evidence is limited.

steps.title: Agree a functional measure
steps.detail: Choose something like walking tolerance or reach.

steps.title: Apply light moves with pauses
steps.detail: Use gentle rolling contacts as trained.

beats.ur:
1. Red flags screen karke patient ka goal samjhein.
2. Evidence limited hone ki wazahat karein.
3. Functional measure choose karein, jaise walking tolerance ya reach.
4. Training ke mutabiq gentle rolling contacts aur pauses use karein.
5. Measure retest karein.
6. Exercise aur medical follow-up jari rakhein. Koi proven dose nahi; session light aur brief rakhein.

beats.patient: Linda, 58, librarian with mild neck stiffness, asks for gentle bodywork.
beats.assessment: No red flags; neck rotation slightly limited.
beats.treatment: She receives a gentle session and also learns neck exercises.
beats.reassess: She feels relaxed but rotation is unchanged. The practitioner explains that relaxation is not proof of functional change, and focuses on exercises.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Source mein Linda, 58 saal ki librarian, mild neck stiffness ke liye gentle bodywork chahti hain. Red flags nahi aur rotation thori limited hai. Gentle session aur neck exercises hoti hain. Woh relaxed feel karti hain magar rotation nahi badalti; clinician samjhata hai ke relaxation functional change ka proof nahi aur exercises par focus karta hai.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Claiming a nervous-system reset.
• Skipping screening.
• Using it instead of needed treatment.
**Myth to drop:** 'The pause proves the nervous system has been reset.' No validated reset test exists.
text.ur: Nervous system reset ka claim, screening skip karna, ya zaroori treatment ke badal ke taur par use karna ghaltiyan hain. Pause reset prove karta hai? Nahi. Kya measure karna chahiye? Functional outcome. Systematic review mein rigorous studies kam theen, is liye strong claims justified nahi.

question.en: Is the pause proven to reset the nervous system?
question.ur: Is the pause proven to reset the nervous system?

text.en:
A systematic review found few rigorous studies, so strong claims are not justified.
A systematic review identified very few rigorous studies, so convincing condition-specific effectiveness claims are not warranted.
text.ur: Bowen Technique ke clinical benefits ke liye high-quality evidence limited ho sakta hai. Patient-reported response ko honestly record karein aur guaranteed cure, detox ya permanent correction jaise claims avoid karein.

text.en: One line to carry into the clinic: **Gentle and pleasant, but judge it by function, not calm.**
